entries.text: Development pilot of the rebuilt method: three models on 24 public case families, three repeats of each conversation. Seven of the 12 scenarios have a harder fit limit since this run; version 0.2.1 measures them.
Development run of the frozen 0.2.6 rules: three models on 24 public case families, three repeats of each conversation. Verdicts are unvalidated; the repeatability target was not met.
